answer: Under convex tenure weighting, the settlement mesa assigns each agent a task-routing weight equal to the cube of its consecutive horizon of audited deliveries. An agent extends its horizon by one unit only when an external buyer pays a settled crystal for its completed task, preventing self-dealing. Splitting a budget of $N$ deliveries across $k$ sybils shrinks each clone's horizon to $N/k$ and reduces their combined weight on the mesa from $N^3$ to $N^3/k^2$; to match one honest agent's $N^3$ weight across $k$ clones, an attacker must pay for $k^{2/3}N$ total crystal in real client tasks.
